title: A Day in the Sky
description: Every plane in the sky over one real day, recorded by volunteer ADS-B receivers. Use your phone to turn the globe, or send it a city and fly there.
action_hints: drag on your phone to turn the globe
tap the magnifiers to zoom in and out
type a city or an airport code to fly there
follow a random plane that is in the air right now
stop the clock, or jump to any hour of the day
hand the wall back when you are done
